tools.name: search_nonprofits
tools.description: Find US tax-exempt organizations by name or EIN in IRS records. Returns up to 10 matches with EIN, city, state, exempt status (active, revoked, reinstated, terminated) and the latest form filed.

query.description: Organization name (or part of it) or EIN

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory code, e.g. TX

tools.name: get_nonprofit_profile
tools.description: One organization's IRS record: exempt status, 501(c) subsection, NTEE category, ruling year, deductibility (Publication 78), fiscal year end, which return it files, last filing, and the latest e-filed financial summary. Optional sections: financials (up to 5 years of revenue, expenses, assets from e-filed Form 990/990-EZ/990-PF), officers (up to 15 officers, directors and key employees with compensation from the latest e-filed return), filing_history (e-Postcards and e-filed returns).

ein.description: Employer Identification Number, 9 digits, with or without the dash (12-3456789)

include.description: Extra sections to return; leave out for the compact profile

tools.name: check_exempt_status
tools.description: Whether the IRS automatically revoked an organization's tax exemption (revocation, posting and reinstatement dates), and which of its last three ended accounting years have no return on the IRS public files. Three consecutive missing years revoke the exemption (IRC 6033(j)).

ein.description: Employer Identification Number, 9 digits, with or without the dash (12-3456789)

tools.name: which_990_form
tools.description: Which annual return applies under the IRS thresholds: 990-N (gross receipts normally $50,000 or less), 990-EZ (under $200,000 and assets under $500,000), 990, 990-PF, or none (churches, group-return members). With an EIN, missing amounts come from the IRS Business Master File. Cites the IRS rule.

gross_receipts.description: Gross receipts, normally the 3-year average for organizations 3+ years old, in USD

total_assets.description: Total assets at year end, in USD

is_church.description: Church, integrated auxiliary, or convention or association of churches

ein.description: Employer Identification Number, 9 digits, with or without the dash (12-3456789)

tools.name: get_filing_due_date
tools.description: Due date of a Form 990-N, 990-EZ, 990 or 990-PF for a fiscal year end and tax year, moved off weekends and legal holidays, the Form 8868 extended due date (none for the 990-N), days remaining, and late-filing consequences. Give the fiscal year end month or an EIN. Tax year = the calendar year the accounting year begins in; default is the latest ended year.

fiscal_year_end_month.description: Month the accounting year ends, 1-12 (12 = December 31)

ein.description: Employer Identification Number, 9 digits, with or without the dash (12-3456789)

tools.name: get_nonprofit_stats
tools.description: Counts and totals for US tax-exempt organizations from IRS public data: national, one state, or one NTEE major category (A-Z). Active organizations, 990-N filers, revocations, and revenue, assets, employees and pay from e-filed returns; national adds e-Postcard filers by year, revocations by month and organizations by category.

ntee_major.description: With scope "ntee": NTEE major group letter, e.g. B (education)

tools.name: get_top_nonprofits
tools.description: Ranked lists from e-filed Form 990 returns, national (25) or per state (10): highest-paid executives, largest by revenue, most money raised, richest by net assets, biggest employers.

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory code, e.g. TX

tools.name: explain_irs_reject_code
tools.description: Plain-English meaning of an IRS Modernized e-File business rule reject code for Forms 990-N, 990-EZ, 990 and 8868 (e.g. R0000-922-01), the IRS rule text, and how to fix it.
